The default link points to a temporary historical GitHub Actions artifact. Download the artifact ZIP, extract fluent3d-full-offline-collection.zip and import that inner ZIP only. Change the link if the artifact expires. The Microsoft source repository ZIP is not directly installable.

MediaPipe .task models are different from FUTO KeyboardLM GGUF models. The optional runtime APK must be separately installed and signed with the same certificate as FUTO. This link opens documentation, not a prevalidated model download.
